elements.element: The limitation of liability cap applies mutually to each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 10.9 limits “each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement.”

elements.element: The cap's fee component consists of fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: Clause (a) expressly uses “the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The cap equals the greater of the 12-month fee component and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is expressly “the greater of” clause (a)'s 12-month fees and clause (b)'s USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “neither Party shall be liable to the other for any indirect ... damages.”

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “neither Party shall be liable to the other for any ... consequential damages.”

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations is an “Excluded Claim,” and the cap applies “[e]xcept for Excluded Claims.”

elements.element: Liability for breach of data protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of its data protection obligations is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's breach of its security obligations is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's indemnification obligations are included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's gross negligence is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's wilful misconduct is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's fraud is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights is uncapped.
elements.evidence: A Party's infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not damages for purposes of the liability cap.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly provides that all amounts due from the Company are not “damages” for purposes of Section 10.9.

elements.element: The limitation of liability cap applies mutually.
elements.evidence: The cap applies to “each Party's total aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap equals 12 months' fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered cap is the greater of 12 months' paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000, so it does not always equal 12 months' fees.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality obligations is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

elements.element: Liability for wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are outside the cap.

result.reason: The added clause fully implements the preferred position and adds no unrelated operative requirement. The fallback is not independently satisfied because its specified cap is exactly 12 months' fees, whereas the rendered clause includes a USD 1,000,000 floor. Drafting quality is high: the cap, mutual damages exclusion, uncapped carve-outs, and payment-obligation treatment are clearly stated.
